snippet.title: La Locomotora Más Potente Del Mundo Es China. ¿Cómo La Manejan?
snippet.description:
La Shen 24 tiene seis secciones sobre veinticuatro ejes y desarrolla veintiocho mil ochocientos kilovatios. Una sola máquina sustituyó a tres locomotoras en la línea carbonera de Shenshuo y redujo la tripulación de seis personas a dos. Su fuerza depende de la adherencia entre la rueda de acero y el riel, por eso tiene veinticuatro motores independientes y la electrónica vigila que ningún eje patine. La máquina arranca, mantiene la velocidad y se detiene sola, y conoce su posición gracias a los satélites Beidou con corrección desde tierra. En las bajadas los motores se vuelven generadores y devuelven la corriente a la catenaria. Al final, trenes automáticos de más de veinte mil toneladas y un convoy de siete trenes sin enganches.
Los datos proceden del fabricante, del operador y de la prensa del sector. La masa, la tracción en toneladas fuerza, la corriente y la comparación con locomotoras de vapor son cálculos y así se indican.

snippet.title: Clueless Couple Think They Can Outsmart Police After Horrific Hit-and-Run Crash
snippet.description:
#news #police #arrest

A 74-year-old man was crossing the road in his motorized wheelchair when a Range Rover struck him and allegedly continued driving, leaving him critically injured. But what investigators later uncovered suggested an attempt to conceal what had happened. On March 16, 2024, officers in Stuart, Florida, responded to a devastating hit-and-run near the Roosevelt Bridge. When emergency responders arrived, they found Harry Maser seriously injured, with pieces of his wheelchair scattered across the roadway. Despite their efforts to save him, Harry later passed away at the hospital. Investigators eventually traced the vehicle to 40-year-old Stacey Carey. After obtaining search warrants, police discovered the damaged Range Rover hidden beneath a car cover inside a garage. When detectives questioned her 44-year-old fiancé, he initially claimed the vehicle had been damaged by an object that fell from a pickup truck on the highway. However, when investigators confronted him with details of the fatal crash, his explanation quickly changed. He asked to retract his previous statement and acknowledged that he had been trying to protect his fiancée. He also admitted purchasing a car cover and moving the damaged vehicle into the garage. Meanwhile, Stacey reportedly told investigators she knew she had struck something but claimed she didn't realize it was a person. She later explained that she was afraid to come forward. On April 26, 2024, both turned themselves in. Stacey was charged with leaving the scene of an accident involving death and tampering with evidence, while her fiancé faced an evidence-tampering charge. This is body-cam footage of the events.

snippet.title: I pitched to The Prime Minister! 😱
snippet.description:
I’ve been saying this for 6 YEARS!!!

I met the UK Prime Minister today and pitched an idea to him that I think can change the course of Britain. He has no obligation to listen, no obligation to take action, but I’m grateful that I got the chance to pitch.

I tell you all to pitch your ideas, your dreams, every single day, and I know you get nervous doing it. I know you’re embarrassed sometimes. You think you might fail, but I’m not asking you to do anything that I wouldn’t do.

Today, I pitched to the Prime Minister an idea to take the job centres and make them dream centres. I even offered to pay for it. I put my money where my mouth is. I had a clear vision, and I know why it’s important to the country, because people are walking into job centres not to get a job, not because they have hope, but because they have no choice.

We want to take a facility, 450 locations across the country, and turn them into a place where you can walk in there and get knowledge for free, help for free, funding, and, if you really still want one and if there is one, a job. I say it there is one a couple of times. It’s time to think differently. To solve our problems, we must come together.

Please don’t hate me for talking to a politician today. We cannot be divided any longer and solve problems. We have to come together. When the Prime Minister invites me to come and share my ideas, I go. Let’s see what happens next.

snippet.title: Why Phone Scammers Wait Exactly 3 Seconds Before Speaking

snippet.title: Tuzlu Kahve 12. Bölüm Fragman | "Sayın Mehmet Aydınoğlu ile Evlenmeyi Kabul Ediyor musunuz?"
snippet.description:
Tuzlu Kahve 12. Bölüm Fragman | "Yıldırım Nikahını Basalım!"

İstanbul’un köklü ve varlıklı ailelerinden birinin torunu olan Derin, hayatını belirli bir plana göre yaşamaya çalışan, evlenip yuva kurmayı en büyük hedefi haline getirmiş genç bir kadındır. Ancak uzun süredir devam eden ilişkisine rağmen bir türlü gerçekleşmeyen düğün hazırlıkları ve ailesinin bitmek bilmeyen beklentileri, onu her geçen gün daha fazla baskı altına almaktadır.
Diğer tarafta ise yıllardır yurt dışında yaşayan Mehmet, ailevi sebeplerle Türkiye’ye döner. Başarılı, kendi ayakları üzerinde duran ve hayatını alıştığı düzende sürdürmek isteyen Mehmet’in dönüşü, ailesi için yeni umutların başlangıcı olur. Özellikle annesi, oğlunun artık ülkesine, ailesine ve kuracağı yeni hayata bağlanmasını istemektedir. Bunun için oğluna bir gelin adayı bile bulmuştur.
Tam bu dönemde Mehmet’in kardeşi Murat’ın evlilik hazırlıkları, Derin’in hayatında hiç beklemediği kapıları aralar. Murat’ın nişanlısı ve ailesiyle, Derin arasında geçmişe dayanan gerilimler, iki ailenin yollarını kesiştirirken, yıllardır gizli kalmış duyguların ve hesapların da yeniden gündeme gelmesine neden olur.
Bambaşka dünyalara ait gibi görünen Mehmet ve Derin’in yolları, ailelerin beklentileri, geçmişten gelen yükler, sırlar, yanlış anlaşılmalar ve sürpriz karşılaşmalar eşliğinde kesişmeye başlar.
Tuzlu Kahve, aşkın sadece iki insan arasında değil, aileler, gelenekler ve hayatın dayattığı beklentiler arasında da sınandığı; romantik komedi ile aile dramasını iç içe geçiren sıcak, eğlenceli ve duygusal bir hikâye anlatmaktadır.

snippet.description:

Centenares de haitianos salieron nuevamente a las calles de Puerto Príncipe para expresar su apoyo a la presencia militar salvadoreña en su territorio. Durante las concentraciones, los manifestantes corearon el nombre del presidente salvadoreño Nayib Bukele, evidenciando el respaldo ciudadano a las operaciones militares que se desarrollan contra las bandas criminales que operan en el país caribeño.

El Salvador ha anunciado que retirará sus tropas de Haití cuando haya terminado la misión de rescatar a los cuatro militares desaparecidos en territorio haitiano hace 30 días.

snippet.title: ¡BUKELE, BUKELE!, celebran en calles y estadio: tropas de El Salvador ACORRALAN A PANDILLAS en Haití
snippet.description:
El programa La Noche de NTN24 repasa cómo los haitianos han salido a las calles de Puerto Príncipe para expresar su respaldo al despliegue militar que mantiene El Salvador en su país, así como los hechos principales de la ofensiva.

Durante las concentraciones, de acuerdo con los videos, se puede escuchar a los haitianos cantar y corear el nombre del presidente salvadoreño, Nayib Bukele, quien ordenó un contundente despliegue militar para rescatar a cuatro militares salvadoreños.

El Salvador ha anunciado que retirará sus tropas de Haití cuando haya terminado la misión de rescatar a los cuatro militares desaparecidos en territorio haitiano hace 30 días.

La información fue comunicada por Gustavo Villatoro, ministro salvadoreño de Justicia y Seguridad Pública, quien lo dijo durante la segunda conferencia internacional sobre estado y democracia en San Salvador a la que asistió el ministro haitiano Patrick Pélissier.

snippet.title: POV: There’s a 90-day Blackout
snippet.description:
Source- Pure speculation 

In a severe 90-day supply blackout where all medications were strictly limited, healthcare priorities would immediately shift toward drugs that prevent rapid, fatal emergencies. While medications for chronic conditions like high blood pressure or high cholesterol protect long-term health over many years, going without them for three months is rarely immediately fatal. Instead, the most critical and valuable medicines would be those that keep vital organs functioning hour by hour or reverse sudden, life-threatening crises, such as insulin for type 1 diabetes, adrenaline autoinjectors for severe allergic reactions, and rescue inhalers for acute asthma attacks. Alongside these emergency rescue drugs, broad-spectrum antibiotics and anti-seizure medications would also become essential for survival. Without reliable sanitation, refrigeration, or rapid hospital care during a prolonged blackout, minor cuts, dental infections, or routine cases of pneumonia can quickly escalate into deadly sepsis if not treated with basic antibiotics. Similarly, daily medications that prevent severe epileptic seizures or maintain heart rhythm are indispensable because stopping them abruptly can trigger life-threatening medical emergencies within days. 

#meds #scenario #curious
